title: A330 OANS
creator: Free Airport Mapping DB, from FlyByWire Simulations' A380X OANS

neutral.LastUpdate: An airport moving map (OANS) on the Headwind A330-900's navigation displays: FlyByWire's A380X OANS, with its map data panel, context menu, flags and crosses, fed by AMDB Bridge. Turn an ND range knob anticlockwise past 10 to show it. GPL-3.0; see README.txt.
